entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, I found some weird comments[n]on Mishima-kun's website.
entries.uk: Слухайте, я знайшла дивні коментарі[n]на сайті Місіми.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They were thanking us for[n]resolving requests that we[n]didn't actually complete.
entries.uk: Нам дякують за виконані запити,[n]яких ми насправді[n]не виконували.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's prolly just a prank.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But those requests are[n]indeed resolved.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Someone must be going into[n]Mementos other than us.
entries.uk: Вочевидь, у Мементос ходить[n]хтось, окрім нас.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think it's Morgana.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Agreed. He's probably taking[n]the Beauty Thief with him too.
entries.uk: Згодна. І, певно, бере з собою[n]Злодійку краси.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should look into this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was thinking of persuading[n]Okumura-san at school, but[n]she's been avoiding me.
entries.uk: Я хотіла переконати Окумуру[n]в школі, але вона[n]мене уникає.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How're we gonna look[n]into this then?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll stake out Mementos.
Good plan.
Like a detective.
I want to get home early.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'd rather chase 'em down[n]instead of sit and wait.
entries.uk: Я б краще за ними погнався,[n]ніж сидіти й чекати.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not sure how I feel about[n]you saying that. I mean, we're[n]the Phantom Thieves...
entries.uk: Якось дивно таке від тебе чути.[n]Ми ж усе-таки[n]Фантомні Злодії...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That'll depend on Mona[n]and the Beauty Thief.
entries.uk: Це залежить від Мони[n]та Злодійки краси.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The method is indeed a classic[n]one, but it is a safe bet.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I think it's better than[n]just looking for them randomly.
entries.uk: Так, це краще, ніж шукати їх[n]навмання.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm gonna have all sorts of[n]snacks! No teachers to stop[n]me on this field trip!
entries.uk: Наберу купу всяких смаколиків![n]На цій екскурсії вчителі[n]мене не зупинять!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Welp, why don't we[n]get this over with?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's do it tomorrow.
